About the author

ME

Maya Ellis

Maya has been weaving with palm and coconut leaves for over fifteen years. She founded LeafCraftPRO to keep traditional leaf craft alive and to teach it in plain, honest language.

All guides by Maya
LeafCraftPRO Craft · Learn · Create

LeafCraftPRO crafts unique, beautiful objects from natural palm and coconut leaves, and publishes free step-by-step tutorials so you can weave them yourself. Every guide is tested by hand before it is published.
